fixed_features.three_checkbox_matrices: Preserves three independent source recognition decisions and complete true/false banks.

role_assignments: Every label and supported shape can be valid or invalid; neither dimensions, label, position nor prompt polarity fixes selection. Validity is sampled before compatible entries. Source replay retains original roles only at original parameters.
repair: Unchanged single-item sampling; reject finite candidate pools with a fixed label action globally, by polarity, or by visible shape/polarity when the group contains at least three records. No equal-frequency or fixed correct-choice-count quota.
